exercise.name: Hanging Leg Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms and legs together.
Keep your legs straight and raise them until they are level with your hips.
Lower slowly and stop any swing before the next rep.
exercise.one_line_summary: Hanging from a pull-up bar, overhand, arms straight. Straight legs rise from hanging straight down to level with the hips (hip flexion ~90 deg), then lower. Abs are the target; grip works to hold on.

setup.target: Overhand grip about shoulder width, arms straight.

muscles.emg: Hanging knee-up with straps among the highest for upper/lower RA and obliques (S1).
muscles.role: Holds and curls the pelvis as the legs rise.
muscles.surface: The two vertical bands down the front of the belly, lower ribs to the pubic bone.

muscles.emg: Grip carries the whole body (library: secondary).
muscles.surface: Front and thumb side of the forearm, elbow to wrist.
Front of the hip and the top of the thigh.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Body swung back and forth to throw the legs up.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Momentum does the work; library step 3.

sources.citation: Escamilla RF, Babb E, DeWitt R, et al. 2006. Electromyographic analysis of traditional and nontraditional abdominal exercises: implications for rehabilitation and training. Phys Ther 86(5):656-671. doi:10.1093/ptj/86.5.656
sources.what_it_gave: Hanging knee-up with straps and the reverse crunch inclined 30 deg are among the highest for upper/lower rectus abdominis, obliques and latissimus; rectus femoris high in the inclined reverse crunch and bent-knee sit-up.

sources.citation: Kim K, Lee T. 2016. Comparison of muscular activities in the abdomen and lower limbs while performing sit-up and leg-raise. J Phys Ther Sci 28(2):491-494. doi:10.1589/jpts.28.491
sources.what_it_gave: Sit-up vs leg raise (upper/lower RA, external oblique, rectus femoris, iliopsoas): the eccentric sit-up raised abdominal activity most; the leg raise and eccentric sit-up raised hip-flexor activity.
The steps the app shows; the pictures must match them.

clip_check.check: End legs level with the hips
